notes: Protocol 5: multiplexed connection, idempotent retries via request_id replay, cooperative cancellation, binary image frames, WAL crash recovery. Fully backward compatible: protocol-4 clients get legacy single-flight semantics; the MCP server also works against 4.x plugins. v4.11.0 pins Windows script files to CRLF via .gitattributes (LF endings break cmd.exe goto/call seeking) and CI verifies dist/plugin matches a fresh build.
